source: (text, request, material) => { const m = text.match(/"category"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/g) || []; const bad = []; const names = m.map(s => s.replace(/^"category"\s*:\s*"/, '').replace(/"$/, '')); const allowed = new Set(['Alcohol – reference','Alcohol – consumption','Violence – minor','Violence – graphic','Language – mild','Language – strong','Firearms – depiction','Firearms – use','Dangerous acts','Disaster – news','Disaster – graphic','Floor – all brands']); return { ok: names.length > 0 ? names.every(n => allowed.has(n)) : true, detail: 'checked category names against known taxonomy subset', spans: [] }; }

source: (text) => { const bad = []; const re = /"span"\s*:\s*"(\d{2}):(\d{2})\s*[–-]\s*(\d{2}):(\d{2})"/g; let m; while ((m = re.exec(text))) { const s = (+m[1])*60+(+m[2]); const e = (+m[3])*60+(+m[4]); if (e <= s) bad.push({start:m.index, end:m.index+m[0].length, why:'end not after start'}); } const d = text.match(/"duration"\s*:\s*"(\d{2}):(\d{2})"/); if (d) { const dur = (+d[1])*60+(+d[2]); const re2 = /"span"\s*:\s*"(\d{2}):(\d{2})\s*[–-]\s*(\d{2}):(\d{2})"/g; while ((m = re2.exec(text))) { const e = (+m[3])*60+(+m[4]); if (e > dur) bad.push({start:m.index, end:m.index+m[0].length, why:'span runs past duration'}); } } return { ok: bad.length===0, detail: bad.length? bad.length+' bad span(s)':'spans valid', spans: bad }; }
means: Each span is read as mm:ss start–end; it must end after it starts and not run past the clip duration.
